caption: A water balloon is lobbed over a garden fence and arcs over into a paddling pool on the other side.

sa.check: A water balloon is lobbed over a garden fence.
It lands in a paddling pool on the other side.
The lob comes first, then the arc, then the landing.

pc.expect: It follows one smooth arc, clearing the fence near the top.
pc.fail: It flies flat; or hangs above the fence; or changes direction.

pc.expect: It falls after the peak and lands in the pool with a splash.
pc.fail: It rises again; or hovers; or floats down.

pc.expect: It wobbles in flight as a bag of liquid and splashes or bursts on landing.
pc.fail: It is a rigid ball; or deflates in the air; or bounces out whole and high.

pc.expect: It clears the fence and does not pass through it.
pc.fail: It passes through the fence; or sinks into the pool bottom; or the pool passes through it.
It duplicates; or vanishes in flight; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The balloon, the fence and the pool stay the same.
pc.fail: The balloon changes colour; or the fence changes; or the pool rearranges.
